# Love Mallacoota

> Local directory and visitor guide for Mallacoota, Victoria, Australia (East
> Gippsland, postcode 3892). Curated, locally maintained listings of places to
> eat and drink, places to stay, and things to do, plus a community events
> calendar. Run by Colin Dixon (oze.au). Content is factual business data:
> names, descriptions, categories, addresses, phone numbers, links, and
> geo-coordinates.

Mallacoota is a coastal town at the Mallacoota Inlet, roughly 520 km east of
Melbourne and 550 km south of Sydney, bordered by Croajingolong National Park.

## Pages

- [Home](https://lovemallacoota.au/): overview, video, and map
- [Eat & Drink](https://lovemallacoota.au/food.html): cafes, restaurants, pubs, takeaway, and seafood
- [Stay](https://lovemallacoota.au/accom.html): lodges, motels, holiday houses, and caravan parks
- [Do & See](https://lovemallacoota.au/activity.html): boat hire, tours, galleries, shops, and attractions
- [Community Calendar](https://lovemallacoota.au/calendar.html): markets, meetups, and local events
- [Mallacoota Mouth Archive](https://lovemallacoota.au/archive.html): searchable catalogue of preserved community newsletter issues
- [Contact](https://lovemallacoota.au/contact.html): suggest a listing correction or addition
- [Emergency information](https://lovemallacoota.au/emergency.html): official warning and emergency-service links
- [Editorial policy](https://lovemallacoota.au/editorial-policy.html): publishing and moderation rules
- [Corrections](https://lovemallacoota.au/corrections.html): correction and removal process
- [Accessibility](https://lovemallacoota.au/accessibility.html): accessibility commitment and feedback
- [Privacy](https://lovemallacoota.au/privacy.html): personal information and analytics
- [Terms](https://lovemallacoota.au/terms.html): terms of use

category_tags, description, address, geo, phone, links, opening_hours):
